www.sos.nd.gov.es: la Secretaría de Estado de North Dakota

reg_deadline.en: North Dakota doesn't require voter registration. You do need a valid ID to vote, so have it ready before you go.
reg_deadline.es: North Dakota no exige registro de votantes. Sí necesitas una identificación válida para votar, así que tenla lista antes de ir.
reg_deadline.quote: North Dakota does not require voter registration, but you do need to have a valid form of identification that can be used for voting.

mail_request.en: Get your absentee ballot application to your county auditor by Monday, November 2, 2026. Your ballot still has to reach the auditor by the close of polls on November 3, so apply now.
mail_request.es: Entrega tu solicitud de boleta de voto en ausencia al auditor de tu condado (county auditor) a más tardar el lunes 2 de noviembre de 2026. Tu boleta tiene que llegar al auditor antes del cierre de las urnas el 3 de noviembre, así que pídela ya.
mail_request.quote: November 2, 2026 - Absentee Application Submission Deadline November 3, 2026 - Absentee Ballots Must Be Returned by Close of Polls
mail_request.en_after: Absentee applications closed November 2, 2026. Vote in person on Election Day with your ID.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes de voto en ausencia cerraron el 2 de noviembre de 2026. Vota en persona el Día de las Elecciones con tu identificación.

mail_return.en: Your ballot must be received by the close of polls on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Mail it with your own postage, use a county drop box, or hand it to your county auditor. Polling places won't take it.
mail_return.es: Tu boleta debe llegar antes de que cierren las urnas el martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. Mándala por correo con tu propia estampilla, usa un buzón de entrega del condado o entrégala al auditor de tu condado. Los lugares de votación no la reciben.
mail_return.quote: Absentee ballots must be received by the close of polls on Election Day , and can be returned by mail, county drop box, or in person to the county auditor.

early_hours.en: Only seven counties offer early voting this year: Burleigh, Cass, Grand Forks, Morton, Stark, Stutsman and Ward. Each sets its own dates and hours, and some end before Monday, November 2. Enter your address in My Voting Information to see yours.
early_hours.es: Solo siete condados ofrecen votación anticipada este año: Burleigh, Cass, Grand Forks, Morton, Stark, Stutsman y Ward. Cada uno fija sus fechas y horarios, y algunos terminan antes del lunes 2 de noviembre. Pon tu dirección en My Voting Information para ver los tuyos.
early_hours.quote: Early voting is available in the following counties for the 2026 General Election: Burleigh, Cass, Grand Forks, Morton, Stark, Stutsman, Ward
early_hours.en_after: Early voting has ended. Vote at your polling place on Election Day with your ID.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones con tu identificación.

cure.en: Signature missing or doesn't match? Confirm it with your county auditor before the canvassing board meets on Monday, November 16, 2026.
cure.es: ¿Te faltó la firma o no coincide? Confírmala con el auditor de tu condado antes de que se reúna la junta de escrutinio el lunes 16 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.en_after: The deadline to confirm a mail ballot signature was the county canvassing board meeting on Monday, November 16, 2026.
cure.es_after: La fecha límite para confirmar la firma de una boleta por correo fue la reunión de la junta de escrutinio del condado el lunes 16 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.quote: verification must be completed by the absent voter before close of the meeting of the canvassing board occurring thirteen days after the election
cure.notes: Canvassing board date Nov 16, 2026 from the SOS 2026 general election media guide.

in_person.en: Seven counties offer early voting: Burleigh, Cass, Grand Forks, Morton, Stark, Stutsman and Ward. On Election Day, vote at the polling location for your precinct, or at any vote center in your county if it uses them. You must have lived in your precinct for 30 days before the election. If you moved within 30 days, vote in the precinct where you lived before.
in_person.es: Siete condados ofrecen votación anticipada: Burleigh, Cass, Grand Forks, Morton, Stark, Stutsman y Ward. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación de tu precinto, o en cualquier centro de votación de tu condado si tu condado los usa. Debes haber vivido en tu precinto 30 días antes de la elección. Si te mudaste en los últimos 30 días, vota en el precinto donde vivías antes.
in_person.quote: Early voting is available in the following counties for the 2026 General Election: Burleigh, Cass, Grand Forks, Morton, Stark, Stutsman, Ward ... Voters must reside in their precinct for at least 30 days prior to the election. If they have moved within 30 days of election day, they must vote in the precinct where they lived previously.

first_time.en: Moved since your ND ID was issued? Update it with the Department of Transportation if you can. If not, bring your ID plus a current bank statement, utility bill, paycheck or government document with your new address.
first_time.es: ¿Te mudaste desde que te dieron tu identificación de North Dakota? Actualízala con el Departamento de Transporte si puedes. Si no, lleva tu identificación junto con un estado de cuenta bancario, un recibo de servicios, un talón de pago o un documento del gobierno reciente con tu nueva dirección.
first_time.quote: You can bring your non-updated, North Dakota issued identification along with supplemental information that includes your updated address to the polling location on Election Day.

locator_label.en: My Voting Information (North Dakota Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Buscador oficial de información para votar (Secretaría de Estado de North Dakota)

rule.en: Enter your address in the My Voting Information portal to see your polling location, its hours and your sample ballot. Some counties use vote centers, where you can vote at any one in the county.
rule.es: Escribe tu dirección en el buscador oficial del estado (My Voting Information) para ver tu lugar de votación, su horario y tu boleta de muestra. Algunos condados usan centros de votación, donde puedes votar en cualquiera del condado.
rule.quote: You can enter your address into the My Voting Info portal to find out where you can go to vote based on where you live.

en: Long-term care certificate from a North Dakota facility you live in
es: Licencia de conducir de North Dakota
Identificación de North Dakota para personas que no manejan (non-driver ID)
Certificado de cuidado a largo plazo de un centro de North Dakota donde vives (long-term care certificate)
accepted.quote: North Dakota is the only state without voter registration as our Voter ID Law requires a valid form of ID to vote. Valid forms of ID that can be used for voting are:

expired.notes: No expired-ID rule found on the SOS Forms of Voter ID page. It does say NDDOT digital IDs are not accepted and out-of-state IDs can't be used with supplemental documents.

without.en: No valid ID with you? You can vote a set-aside ballot. It counts once you show your ID to your county auditor, in person or electronically, within 13 days after the election, before the County Canvassing Board meets.
without.es: ¿No traes una identificación válida? Puedes votar con una boleta apartada (set-aside ballot). Se cuenta cuando muestras tu identificación al auditor de tu condado, en persona o por medios electrónicos, dentro de los 13 días después de la elección, antes de que se reúna la junta de escrutinio del condado (County Canvassing Board).
without.quote: Within 13 days after the election, you must update or present your driver’s license, non-driver ID, Tribal ID or documentation, or Long Term Care Certificate before the County Canvassing Board meets.

who.en: Any eligible voter can vote absentee. No one gets a ballot without applying first. In vote-by-mail counties, the county auditor mails you the application.
who.es: Cualquier votante con derecho puede votar en ausencia. Nadie recibe una boleta sin pedirla antes. En los condados que votan por correo, el auditor del condado te manda la solicitud por correo.
who.quote: In vote by mail counties, voting age residents are mailed an absentee ballot application by their county auditor.

witness.en: Sign the return envelope yourself. Your county compares that signature with the one on your application.
witness.es: Firma tú mismo el sobre de devolución. Tu condado compara esa firma con la de tu solicitud.
witness.quote: Signatures from the absentee ballot application are compared to the signature on the returned ballot envelope. Only you should sign your absentee ballot return envelope.

cure.en: If your signature is missing or doesn't match, your county auditor will contact you. Confirm it's yours in person with your ID, or by letter or email with a copy of the ID you used to apply, before the county canvassing board meets on Monday, November 16.
cure.es: Si te faltó la firma o no coincide, el auditor de tu condado te contactará. Confirma que es tuya en persona con tu identificación, o por carta o correo electrónico con una copia de la identificación que usaste al solicitarla, antes de que se reúna la junta de escrutinio del condado el lunes 16 de noviembre.
cure.quote: verification must be completed by the absent voter before close of the meeting of the canvassing board occurring thirteen days after the election
cure.notes: Canvassing board date Nov 16, 2026 from the SOS 2026 general election media guide.
cure.en_after: The deadline to confirm a mail ballot signature was the county canvassing board meeting on Monday, November 16, 2026.
cure.es_after: La fecha límite para confirmar la firma de una boleta por correo fue la reunión de la junta de escrutinio del condado el lunes 16 de noviembre de 2026.

dropbox.en: Every county has secure absentee ballot drop boxes. Get your ballot in one by the close of polls on Election Day, or hand it to your county auditor.
dropbox.es: Cada condado tiene buzones de entrega seguros para boletas de voto en ausencia. Deja tu boleta en uno antes de que cierren las urnas el Día de las Elecciones, o entrégala al auditor de tu condado.
dropbox.quote: Strategically placed secure absentee ballot drop boxes are provided in each county for voters who wish to deliver their absentee ballot directly to the county. Ballots must be placed in the drop box by the close of polls on Election Day.

gear.en: Leave the campaign buttons and hats at home. Within 100 feet of the polling place entrance, and inside, you can't wear political badges, buttons or insignias, or try to sway anyone's vote.
gear.es: Deja en casa los botones y gorras de campaña. A menos de 100 pies de la entrada del lugar de votación, y adentro, no puedes llevar insignias, botones ni distintivos políticos, ni tratar de influir en el voto de nadie.
gear.quote: Political badges, buttons, insignias, or other items may not be worn within 100 feet from the entrance of a polling place or in the polling place while it is open for voting.

phone.en: North Dakota's election law doesn't address photos of your ballot or phones in the voting booth. The Secretary of State notes that photography in a polling place can intimidate voters. Ask a poll worker before you take a picture inside, and keep other voters out of it.
phone.es: La ley electoral de North Dakota no dice nada sobre fotos de tu boleta ni sobre teléfonos en la cabina de votación. La Secretaría de Estado advierte que tomar fotos en un lugar de votación puede intimidar a los votantes. Pregunta a un trabajador electoral antes de tomar una foto adentro, y no incluyas a otros votantes.
phone.quote: Recognize that filming and photography in a polling location may be intimidating to voters who are voting.

line.en: If you're in line when the polls close, stay in line. You can still vote. People who arrive after closing can't.
line.es: Si estás en la fila cuando cierran las casillas, no te salgas. Todavía puedes votar. Quien llegue después del cierre ya no puede.
line.quote: All electors standing in line to vote at the time the polls are set to close must be allowed to vote, but electors arriving after closing time may not be allowed to vote.

tradition.en: For 2026, the North Dakota Secretary of State's office held its first I Voted sticker contest. Haylee Senger of Bottineau designed the winner, "You Betcha I Voted." The contest drew 478 artists, and 4,792 North Dakotans voted to pick the winner. The sticker debuted at the June 9 primary.
tradition.es: Para 2026, la Secretaría de Estado de North Dakota hizo su primer concurso de stickers "I Voted". Haylee Senger, de Bottineau, diseñó el ganador, "You Betcha I Voted". Participaron 478 artistas, y 4,792 personas de North Dakota votaron para elegir al ganador. El sticker se estrenó en las primarias del 9 de junio.
tradition.quote: For the first time, the North Dakota Office of the Secretary of State held a contest to select a new “I Voted” sticker for the state. Haylee Senger from Bottineau submitted the winning “You Betcha I Voted” sticker design, which debuted at the polls during the 2026 Primary Election on June 9. ... Designs were submitted by 478 artists of all ages and skill levels from all corners of the state. Four finalists were selected and then 4,792 North Dakotans voted to decide the winner.

provisional.en: North Dakota uses a set-aside ballot if you don't have a valid ID with you. Show your ID to the county auditor within 13 days after the election, before the County Canvassing Board meets, and your ballot will be counted.
provisional.es: North Dakota usa una boleta apartada (set-aside ballot) si no traes una identificación válida. Muestra tu identificación al auditor del condado dentro de los 13 días después de la elección, antes de que se reúna la junta de escrutinio del condado, y tu boleta se contará.
provisional.quote: You may submit your identification to the county auditor, in person or electronically, and your ballot will be counted.

track.en: Use the state's absentee ballot tracker to see whether your county received your ballot.
track.es: Usa el buscador oficial del estado para seguir tu boleta de voto en ausencia (absentee ballot tracker) y ver si tu condado ya la recibió.
track.quote: You can track your ballot to see if your ballot was received.

late_mail.en: Don't bring it to your polling place; absentee ballots aren't accepted there on Election Day. Put it in a county drop box or hand it to your county auditor before polls close.
late_mail.es: No la lleves a tu lugar de votación; ahí no aceptan boletas de voto en ausencia el Día de las Elecciones. Déjala en un buzón de entrega del condado o entrégala al auditor de tu condado antes de que cierren las urnas.
late_mail.quote: They will NOT be accepted at polling locations on Election Day.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 with curl on sos.nd.gov (Voting in North Dakota, Forms of Voter ID, How Do I Vote, Absentee Voting, Where Do I Vote, Elections - Current/Past, I Voted Sticker Design Contest) and vip.sos.nd.gov (Precincts.aspx?eid=348, page 1 of the early voting list). Weekday for November 2 is the calendar weekday. NO VOTER REGISTRATION: the file uses the SOS sentence 'North Dakota does not require voter registration, but you do need to have a valid form of identification that can be used for voting.' and 'North Dakota is the only state without voter registration as our Voter ID Law requires a valid form of ID to vote.' Polls close between 7 and 9 p.m. local time depending on the county (faq_text.py), so mail_return says 'close of polls' as the SOS does. EARLY VOTING FOR THE LEAD (states.js has ND unchecked): no statewide window. 'Some communities offer early voting at certain dates and times prior to Election Day.' (https://www.sos.nd.gov/elections/voter/voting-north-dakota/how-do-i-vote), with the county list at https://vip.sos.nd.gov/Precincts.aspx?eid=348 ('Early Voting Available Counties'). Page 1 of that list (page 2 needs a postback and was not opened) shows: Burleigh (Bismarck Event Center) Oct 22 to Nov 2, 2026, with 'Oct 22 2026 12:00PM-Oct 22 2026 5:30PM' first and 'Nov 2 2026 9:00AM-Nov 2 2026 5:00PM' last; Cass (five Fargo-area sites) Oct 27 to Oct 31, 'Oct 27 2026 11:00AM-Oct 27 2026 7:00PM'; Grand Forks (Alerus Center) Oct 27 to Oct 31; Morton (Mandan Public Library) Oct 27 to Nov 2; Sioux County one-evening absentee voting days Oct 28 and Oct 30. Absentee voting began 'September 24, 2026 - Absentee Begins' (elections-currentpast). Suggested states.js note: 'Early voting in some counties only; dates vary. Check your county.' Not found: statewide early voting hours, cure process, expired-ID rule, phone and line rules.

hours.en: Your city or county sets the hours: polls open between 7 and 9 a.m. and close between 7 and 9 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Tu ciudad o condado fija el horario: se abre entre las 7 y las 9 a. m. y se cierra entre las 7 y las 9 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: The polls at all primary, general, and special elections must be opened at nine a.m. or earlier, but not earlier than seven a.m., as designated for any precinct by resolution of the governing body of the city or county in which the precinct is located. The polls must remain open continuously until seven p.m. or a later hour, not later than nine p.m.
hours.quote2: The polls must remain open continuously until seven p.m. or a later hour, not later than nine p.m.
